data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil). Prior year claims development is analysis by line of business in the table below.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 18.715m. During 2015 there was a gross prior year release of GBP 6.898m (a 36.9% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable prior-year claims development and reinsurance recoveries across several lines of business (net favourable development of GBP 4.8m is disclosed). The movement is reflected in the Technical Provisions note and the prior-year analysis by line of business.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and gross prior-year movement taken from Statement of Financial Position and Technical Provisions note (note 17) respectively (both explicit). The prior-year development gross figure is available and used (-GBP 6.898m). The per-line prior year development table shown in the managing agent narrative provides NET by line of business (net favourable GBP 4.797m) - lob_movements entries are therefore net figures (converted to millions and sign-adjusted to 'release' negative convention) and have lower confidence. No named catastrophe events affecting prior years are identified in the document.
